issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'εν αφθαρσια' (in incorruptibility/immortality) modifies the love ('των αγαπωντων... εν αφθαρσια' = those loving... in incorruptibility), but the Chinese renders it as '用不朽的愛' (with immortal love), which changes the meaning from 'loving in/with incorruptibility' (i.e., in a state of incorruption) to 'with an immortal love' (attributing immortality to the love itself). This is a substantive shift in the claim.
